t: 在日本,武田信玄击败了德川一也.
te: In Japan, Takeda Shingen defeats Tokugawa Ieyasu.

t: 华沙联邦签署条款,批准波兰的宗教自由.
te: Articles of the Warsaw Confederation are signed, sanctioning freedom of religion in Poland.
dz: 华沙联邦签署条款,批准波兰的宗教自由.
de: Articles of the Warsaw Confederation are signed, sanctioning freedom of religion in Poland.

t: 奥斯曼帝国与威尼斯共和国签订和平条约,结束了奥斯曼-威尼斯战争,将塞浦路斯交给了奥斯曼手中.
te: A peace treaty is signed between the Ottoman Empire and the Republic of Venice, ending the Ottoman–Venetian War and lea…
dz: 奥斯曼帝国与威尼斯共和国签订和平条约,结束了奥斯曼-威尼斯战争,将塞浦路斯交给了奥斯曼手中.
de: A peace treaty is signed between the Ottoman Empire and the Republic of Venice, ending the Ottoman–Venetian War and leaving Cyprus in Ottoman hands.

t: 八十年战争:哈勒姆之围7个月后结束.
te: The Siege of Haarlem ends after seven months.
dz: 八十年战争:哈勒姆之围7个月后结束.

t: 西班牙对阿尔克马尔的围攻以80年战争中第一次荷兰取胜而告终.
te: The Spanish siege of Alkmaar ends with the first Dutch victory in the Eighty Years' War.
